compatibility_rule: A contents or internal-link record may join the ledger only when its geometry edition, province, depth support, and valid time exactly equal the ledger address and valid time. A static-structure overlay may use temporal_support=static_reference but must exactly match the ledger address. A boundary context remains separate unless an explicit compatible bridge is declared.
prohibitions: No scalar state-health or interaction score.
No residual is relabeled as mixing, entrainment, or vertical transfer.
No open-edge transport is relabeled as interior convergence.
No temperature distribution is relabeled as heat content or water-mass transformation.
unknown_policy: Unknown relations are retained with a reason; an empty relation list is not evidence of absence.
